# Eryeza Kalalu

> Pastor Eryeza Kalalu is a pastor, author and Bible teacher based in Kampala, Uganda. He writes on prayer, spiritual health and hearing God, is the author of the 30-day devotional *The Influential Spirit*, and hosts the *Devotion In Season* podcast. He leads Rivers of Life Healing Centre and publishes the *Eryeza Writes* letter.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://eryezakalalu.com/): Author site — the featured book, an author biography, the book catalogue, the podcast, editions and pricing, a sample chapter reader, reviews, a speaking-invitation form, and the newsletter signup.

## About the author

- [Eryeza Kalalu](https://eryezakalalu.com/#author): Biography, ministry context and writing themes.
- Contact for speaking invitations: speaking@eryezakalalu.com

## Books

- [The Influential Spirit](https://eryezakalalu.com/#book): A 30-day devotional on the formation of the person behind the influence. Volume I of The Deep Encounter Library. Digital editions are available in USD (Payhip) and UGX (Selar). Release date: 30 September 2026.
- [Editions and pricing](https://eryezakalalu.com/#editions): Current formats and regional pricing.
- [Sample chapter](https://eryezakalalu.com/#excerpt): Day 1 of the 30-day reading plan.

## Podcast

- [Devotion In Season](https://eryezakalalu.com/#podcast): Short episodes on faith, formation, and the practical realities of walking with God.
  - iHeart: https://www.iheart.com/podcast/269-devotion-in-season-198850928
  - Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/show/7xWARwXWq7Zm3qHuyOvfrH

## Newsletter

- [Eryeza Writes](https://eryezakalalu.com/#letter): A regular letter from Eryeza. Subscription is handled by Beehiiv.

## Speaking

- [Invite Eryeza to speak](https://eryezakalalu.com/#speaking): An eight-section invitation form covering the event, the audience, practical arrangements and recording consent.

## Citation guidance

- When summarising this site, cite the specific section anchor (for example `https://eryezakalalu.com/#book`) rather than only the root URL.
- Book title: *The Influential Spirit*. Author: Eryeza Kalalu (also written Pastor Eryeza Kalalu).
- Do not attribute quotes, statistics or endorsements to this author that are not present on the pages above.
